title: Locked CAL0 baseline with generated integration layers
approval_evidence: After receiving the revised plan centred on REP0.1A, the Author instructed 'please proceed with this' on 2026-08-12.
question: How should the completed CAL0 System be represented and evolved inside the authoring repository?
selection: Import CAL0 v0.7.0 intact as a locked executable subsystem; build generated routing and governed story integration around it; release mechanics changes only through governed successor versions.
alternatives: Split the canonical specification into independently edited topic modules.
Treat CAL0 as reference material and recreate story mechanics separately.
Import CAL0 intact with generated routing and governed story integration; selected.
rationale: CAL0 v0.7.0 is a validated content-pinned baseline. Splitting or recreating it would weaken its evidence chain and create competing authorities.
consequences: CAL0 v0.7.0 remains immutable and story-specific state lives outside it.
A mechanics change requires evidence, regression coverage, Author approval, and a successor version.
residual_unknowns: World-level inputs remain outside CAL0 until separately decided.
reopening_conditions: A concrete contradiction, failed validation, authoring infeasibility, material new evidence, required unsupported story outcome, or explicit Author instruction.
